tools.name: invoice_extract
tools.title: Extract structured fields from an invoice
tools.description: Worked-example skill server bound by the Skills Registry's finance/invoice-extract entry. Pass the URL of a PDF or image invoice; returns vendor, invoice number, issue/due dates, currency, line items, subtotal/tax/total. Deterministic OCR+rules pipeline (stubbed in this spike — returns canned data that matches examples/invoice-extract/sample-output.json so an agent can prove the registry → binding → invoke loop end-to-end).

document_url.description: HTTPS URL of the invoice PDF or image to extract.
